description:
It seems my brother’s fiancée is having an affair with a coworker. Determined to stop the wedding within two months, Ian goes undercover, taking a job as the personal secretary to the CEO of the company where her future sister-in-law works.

*"Do you think boundaries exist just to be crossed?"*

Unfortunately for her, that CEO is Cha Jeonghan, a man as strikingly handsome as he is utterly unbearable. With his cutting remarks and infuriating composure, he makes it his personal mission to provoke Ian at every turn.

*"Yes. Boundaries exist to be crossed."*

With nothing to lose, not even her job, Ian decides to trample over Jeonghan’s carefully drawn lines whenever she pleases. And slowly, the once-arrogant man who never deigned to look down from his lofty pedestal begins to falter.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
